structure.signature_definition: Per-position op type/pipe/max(1,cycles), produced tensor sizes and producer/consumer positions, original COPY_OUT incidence, and eligible dependency position pairs. External shared inputs are excluded from frontier by definition.

original_terminal_COPY_OUT.note: These original terminal COPY_OUT inputs have no right-side compute consumer when terminal_only. They are not cross-stage frontiers.

interpretation: Frontier means an original tensor has a mapped compute producer at positions <=h and a mapped compute consumer at positions >h in the same job. Count tensors, not edges.
ceil(bytes/60) is per-tensor arithmetic service demand for one copy at nominal bandwidth, not actual contended latency, not P3 Makespan, and not an official lower bound.
No candidate plan generated; cumulative compute is max(1,cycles) prefix sum, not a solver or E0 timing. No optimization result or cut choice is certified.
cpu_scope: Python process_time excludes Git read child CPU; watchdog outer wall includes that child.
